summary: Iteration 9 - Verified 'demo accounts not working' fix. Created /app/backend/tests/test_seed_demo_accounts.py (12 tests, all PASS in 8.2s). Also drove the full 3-step UI login (send-otp -> verify-otp -> login-password) on the preview URL for all 4 demo phones. Every requested check from the review request passes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4455 lines - continues to grow. seed-demo-accounts + _do_seed + auth routes can be extracted into /app/backend/routes/admin.py and routes/auth.py.

DEMO_ACCOUNTS list inside seed_demo_accounts (server.py:2976-2982) is a magic in-line constant. If the same data is needed in tests or a CLI seeder, hoist to a module-level DEMO_ACCOUNTS tuple so tests can import it and avoid drift.

seed_demo_accounts sets security_setup_required=False on the crm_users doc, but the FE still force-redirects the 3 provider_owner phones to /security-setup because /verify-otp response reports has_recovery_email=False & has_security_questions=False. Either (a) also seed a dummy recovery_email + 2 pre-answered security questions so the demo accounts skip setup and land straight in the provider dashboard, OR (b) update test_credentials.md to document the security-setup redirect as expected behaviour for these 3 accounts. Right now the docs at lines 29/33/38 only say 'NOT YET SET' for ambulance but not hospital/pathology - minor doc gap.

The comment at server.py:318-319 ('only ambulance provider portals are supported here. Hospital/clinic/path-lab owners belong to the separate HMS and must not be allowed to log in.') is now STALE after this fix - hospital + pathology ARE now supported. Please update the comment to match SUPPORTED_PROVIDER_TYPES.

rca of the issue: Bug: pre-fix, phone 9000020003 hit /auth/verify-otp -> 403 'Phone not authorized' because no crm_users row existed. Root cause: previous seed logic only inserted Priya + Rohan; no idempotent path existed to add the 3 provider_owner demo accounts. Fix in server.py: (1) expanded SUPPORTED_PROVIDER_TYPES from ambulance-only to {ambulance, hospital, pathology, doctor, paramedic, pharmacy} via PROVIDER_TYPE_TO_CONTACT_TYPE dict (lines 71-79), (2) added POST /api/admin/seed-demo-accounts endpoint (lines 2967-3031) that inserts the 4 canonical rows into crm_users + matching contacts into db.contacts, guarded by find_one({phone}) for idempotency and gated behind is_master_admin/role==admin (403 for anyone else). Verified: 12/12 pytest, 4/4 UI logins.
